description.value: Investigation of resting-state functional connectivity alterations of anterior and posterior right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex subdivisions in Parkinson's disease patients compared with healthy controls under dopaminergic medication withdrawal and regular medication.

quotes: To investigate whether these functionally distinct subdivisions of right dlPFC are differentially affected in PD, we analyzed resting-state functional connectivity (FC) in 39 PD patients and 44 age- and gender-matched healthy controls.

description.value: Observational case-control study with repeated resting-state fMRI scans of Parkinson's disease patients after at least 12 hours of dopaminergic medication withdrawal and under regular medication; healthy controls were scanned under their usual condition.
